answer.reason: Beyond the lists, the verses say it was given to the Levites and that judgment was pronounced on it.

clauses.english: was given with its suburbs to the Levites of the family of Merari
clauses.quote: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs

clauses.english: had judgment come upon it with the cities of the plain country
clauses.quote: judgment is come upon the plain country

doubts: JER 48:21 is a prophecy of judgment on Moab's cities, stated in the present tense; the clause relies on that wording.
JOS 13:18 and 1CH 6:79 only list the name and were not used as separate clauses.
